import math

# N = 2025
# If we use the sequence (1, 2, 3) repeated K times, where K = N/3
K = 675

# We calculate C(K+2, 3)
# C(n, k) = n! / (k! * (n-k)!)
n = K + 2
k = 3

# C(677, 3) = 677 * 676 * 675 / 6
result = (n * (n - 1) * (n - 2)) // math.factorial(k)

print(result)
